text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now begins the journey of racing through the Twinkle Series alongside my trainee Umamusume.
The name of the girl who will walk this path with me is—

color_text_info_list.Text: トゥインクル・シリーズ

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am Rose Kingdom.
Fufu, pay it no mind... I merely wished to reintroduce myself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Rose Clan's deepest yearning—
to establish the 'Rose Kingdom' is my sole mission.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Without fail, we shall prove the Rose Clan's presence to the racing world.
I am counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so began our challenge in the Twinkle Series alongside <chrname>!
